trackSummary.rationale: Of the assessed upward transitions, the onset after the extended quiet break has clear preparation, a distinct impact, and sustained higher energy. The other returns lack a comparably distinct impact at their anchors.

The strongest re-entry has clear preceding withdrawal and a stronger following section, but its boundary apex does not establish a decisive impact onset. Other rises lack a coherent preparation-and-impact shape.

Two major transitions have preparation and sustained stronger passages, but neither has a clearly isolated impact onset at its anchor. The other assessed rises lack the required preparation or stronger release.

Five independently supported transitions combine withdrawal, a locally distinct onset, and a sustained stronger passage. Three shorter or less decisive re-entries remain ambiguous rather than being treated as drops.

The two major upward transitions lead to sustained stronger passages, but neither establishes a decisive impact at its assessed anchor. The later return has clear preparation yet remains ambiguous on impact morphology; the other assessed transitions do not show a complete preparation–impact–stronger-passage shape.

Two transitions combine lower-energy preparation, a locally sharp entrance, and sustained stronger activity. The later return from the quiet breakdown grows stronger without a clearly decisive impact at its boundary.
Three transition anchors show a clear preparatory passage, locally sharp onset, and sustained stronger material. A later strong return lacks a clearly localized impact at its transition anchor.
The section entrance lacks clear preparation and a distinct impact. The later re-entry follows a clear breakdown, but the packet does not establish a decisive onset at its anchor.
Two marked returns independently show withdrawal, a locally distinct rise, and sustained stronger passages. A later recovery lacks a clearly anchored impact and remains ambiguous as a drop.

One transition has a clear withdrawal, abrupt impact, and sustained stronger passage. The earlier quiet-to-stronger entrance lacks a comparably distinct impact; another upward transition lacks clear preparation.

Both assessed transitions lead from lower to sustained stronger energy, but neither has a clearly supported decisive impact at its candidate anchor. The later re-entry remains ambiguous rather than a proposed drop.
Two marked re-entries follow substantial quiet passages and have locally sharp onsets with sustained stronger passages. Another marked high-energy entrance has only brief evidence of preparation.

The packet supports structural changes, sustained energy lifts, and several intensity peaks. At the plausible re-entries, the stronger passage develops gradually or is already underway before the anchor; none has clear preparation, a decisive local impact, and a sustained stronger aftermath together.
Two assessed transitions pair clear withdrawal with a distinct impact and sustained stronger passage; the other assessed transitions lack a decisive impact at their anchors.
Three candidates combine a quieter preparation, a distinct onset at the anchor, and a sustained stronger passage. The return after near-silence has uncertain impact placement and remains ambiguous.

Two quiet-to-strong transitions have distinct onset evidence and sustained stronger passages. A later strong re-entry lacks equally clear impact evidence at its candidate anchor; the remaining assessed returns do not show a decisive impact there.
Several entrances and rises have sustained stronger passages, but the plausible release points lack either clear preparation or a decisive impact at the same anchor.

The return from the extended low-demand passage has clear preparation, a distinct impact, and sustained higher energy. The later marked entrance builds toward an apex, but its impact and sustained contrast are less clear.

The later return from a reduced passage has a distinct onset followed by sustained higher energy. The opening entrance and earlier high-energy return lack a clearly localized impact at their candidate anchors.

Of the assessed upward transitions, the return after the long low-energy passage has clear preparation, a concentrated impact, and a sustained stronger passage. The earlier rises lack a distinct impact at their anchors.
The return from the extended quiet section has a sharp onset and sustained stronger passage. The earlier rise is gradual, and the later brief dip only recovers to the prior energy level.

One marked transition has supported preparation, a locally distinct impact, and a sustained stronger aftermath. A later rise has no clearly isolated impact, while another follows only a brief dip and develops gradually.
Most stronger entrances are gradual or lack a distinct impact at their anchors. One later transition combines a brief withdrawal, a sharp onset, and a sustained stronger passage.

The low-demand passage clearly gives way to sustained higher energy, but the available evidence does not locate a decisive impact at its ending anchor. No other clear preparation–impact–stronger-passage transition is identified.

Two marked transitions independently show a lower-energy lead-in, a concentrated upward onset, and a sustained stronger passage. The earlier quiet-break exit rises less decisively, and the late apex lacks a distinct impact at its anchor.

Three assessed re-entries independently show preparation, a concentrated onset, and sustained stronger energy. Another return has a less distinct onset, while the opening rise reads as an energy transition.

Two transitions each have a discernible buildup or lower-energy passage, a concentrated rise, and a sustained stronger continuation. A later lift has a clear rise but only weak evidence of preparation.
Four assessed transitions combine clear preparation, a distinct impact, and sustained stronger energy. The opening lift and a later midlevel re-entry lack equally clear impact evidence.
The opening buildup has a distinct, concentrated release into a sustained stronger section. Later re-entries are energetic, but their candidate anchors do not clearly establish a decisive impact.

Four assessed transitions each have a lower-energy preparation, a locally sharp rise, and a sustained stronger passage. The later increase within an already strong passage and the gradual recovery from a brief dip lack a decisive prepared impact.
Several transitions have a lift or local impact, but none clearly combines preparation, a decisive impact at its anchor, and a sustained stronger passage.
Two assessed transitions pair a lower-energy lead-in with a distinct onset and a sustained stronger passage. Other upward transitions lack a sufficiently distinct impact at their anchors.

The main upward boundary has clear preparation and a stronger passage afterward, but its decisive impact remains unclear. Other assessed re-entries lack the full preparation, impact, and sustained-strength pattern.
Two subdued-to-strong transitions combine sustained preparation, a concentrated onset, and a stronger continuing passage. Other upward transitions lack comparably clear impact morphology.
Several returns and energy rises are evident, but none has clear preparation, a distinct impact at its anchor, and a sustained stronger passage together. Two re-entries retain some impact ambiguity.

The transition after the pronounced quiet passage supports preparation, a distinct impact, and sustained increased energy. The later return has preparation and renewed energy, but its impact morphology remains uncertain.

Four assessed transitions each have a lower-energy preparation, a locally distinct impact, and a sustained stronger passage. The brief dip and recovery at another candidate lacks equally clear preparation and impact evidence.
Five assessed re-entries each combine a lower-energy preparation, a locally distinct onset, and sustained stronger energy. Two other rises have uncertainty about preparation or impact alignment.
Two returns from extended quiet passages have a distinct impact and sustained high energy. The first upward section change lacks a comparably distinct impact at its anchor.
The identifiable re-entry follows a quieter passage but lacks a clearly concentrated impact and clearly sustained stronger passage. Other prominent crests are peaks, while the ending loses energy.

One later transition has a locally distinct impact following a lower passage and build, with sustained high energy afterward. An earlier rise also leads to sustained high energy, but its impact at the available anchor is unclear.

Three assessed transitions each have a lower-energy lead-in, a distinct onset, and a sustained stronger passage. Another strong re-entry has an uncertain impact point; the remaining assessed rises lack a decisive onset.
Both transitions into sustained high-energy sections follow extended lower-energy passages and have nearby onset evidence for distinct impacts; the earlier moderate lift lacks such an impact.

Four transitions each show preparation, a locally distinct impact, and a sustained stronger passage. Two other plausible re-entries lack sufficiently clear preparation or an impact at the candidate anchor.

Two candidates combine a lower-energy lead-in, a distinct impact at the anchor, and a sustained stronger passage. A later strong return has clear preparation and continuation, but its impact at the selected anchor remains uncertain.

Two transitions have a clear quiet preparation, concentrated impact, and sustained stronger passage. The later climactic entrance has uncertain impact placement; other recoveries rise without a decisive onset.
Two transitions independently show preparation, a locally decisive onset, and a sustained stronger passage. Other re-entries either lack a clearly localized impact or follow too little preparation.

The main upward transition has clear lower-energy preparation and a sustained stronger passage, but a decisive impact at its anchor is unclear. The other assessed transitions lack the required preparation-and-impact shape.

The transition out of the extended lower-energy break supports a clear preparation, localized impact, and sustained stronger passage. Another strong return has uncertain impact placement; the other assessed transitions lack a distinct impact or stronger release.

Three assessed onsets each follow a withdrawal or quiet passage, have a distinct local energy jump, and lead into a sustained stronger passage. Other assessed pulses or boundaries lack a separate impact or sustained release.
